newsitem.title: USA: Alliance says 90 pct of notes tendered.
newsitem.headline: Alliance says 90 pct of notes tendered.

text.p: Alliance Gaming Corp said that holders of more than 90 percent of the amount outstanding of the Company's 12-7/8 percent senior secured notes due 2003 have tendered their notes into the company's previously announced tender offer.
The company said those who tendered also consented to amend the indenture under which the notes were issued to delete substantially all restrictive covenants.
The consents obtained represent the required majority of holders, so this amendment will be effective on consummation of the tender offer, the company said.
